# id: PG-pg-89-balance-perception
# covers: PG 199 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold; 6933d0f: fill topup, drop all; 616121b: benches near) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: a fresh neutral observer per point (Hungry Bandit, Drifters, renamed PGW<n>) spawned 20 m from Avarek,
#   who sneaks (detecttime: sneak on). Result = game seconds until seen
#   (timeout 120 s). The observer's skill/gear varies (perception).
#   The observer is killed and moved away after every point.
# verify: seen=1 in most points (seen=0 everywhere: this observer never notices a sneaker, send the .out to
#   the PG agent); stealth: seconds_to_seen grows with Stealth; perception: it shrinks with Perception.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Avarek
clearjobs Avarek
pg_statprobe on Avarek
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 60 ~ moved=1
setstat Avarek stealth 30
# --- w1: perception 10, gear none ---
stealth Avarek off
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 60 ~ moved=1
@set OBS spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Avarek dist 20 count 1 ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)
setname ${OBS} PGW1
relation PGW1 0
setstat PGW1 perception 30
pg_statprobe on PGW1
give PGW1 "Iron Hat" 1
equip PGW1 "Iron Hat"
pg_info PGW1 "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
setstat PGW1 perception 10
pg_clear PGW1 ~ cleared affixes
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek PGW1 dist 20 ~ moved=1
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@echo READY
where PGW1 ~ dist=(\d|[1-2]\d)\.\d
speed 1 hold
@set T detecttime Avarek PGW1 timeout 120 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,199,perception,10,0,none,w1,detect_observer,120,${T},-
pg_statprobe read
stealth Avarek off
kill PGW1
@until 30 teleport PGW1 Avarek dist 300 ~ moved=1
# --- w2: perception 90, gear none ---
stealth Avarek off
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 60 ~ moved=1
@set OBS spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Avarek dist 20 count 1 ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)
